topic: Retrieving a Card from an ATM

script.title: THE ATM ATE MY CARD
script.scene_zh: 銀行大廳 · 找回提款卡
script.story_hook: A bank ATM keeps someone's card on a freezing night.
script.intro_zh: 寒夜裡，銀行的提款機吞走了一張卡。
script.welcome_en: Hi everyone, welcome back! Today an ATM ate a card. Let's fix it in English.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨各位，歡迎回來！今天提款機吞了卡——我們用英文處理它。
script.outro: All fixed for today! Listen again and stay tuned. Warm hands, warm English!
script.outro_zh: 今天的狀況解決了！再聽一遍，別走開。手要暖，英文也要熱起來！
script.practice_intro_en: Follow along now — repeat after me, line by line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟上——一句一句跟著我重複。
script.char_a_description: a college-age white girl in her early twenties with pastel-purple dyed pigtails, thick round glasses, a bubblegum-pink parka with fluffy ear muffs, hopping from foot to foot out in the cold
script.char_b_description: a calm Native American man in his fifties with long iron-grey hair tied in a low ponytail, a navy security uniform with a shoulder patch, holding a small clipboard under the warm lobby lights
script.youtube_title: 【🏧💳提款機吞卡怎麼辦】「機器吃了我的卡」怎麼說？聽完就會找回卡｜🔑ATM Card Recovery English
script.youtube_title_en: “The Machine Just Ate My Card” — Getting a Card Back from an ATM
script.youtube_description:
深夜提款機把卡吞了，周邊只有一位保全大哥？這段大廳裡的即時對話教你：報提款機編號、登記姓名與時間、問營業時間、補發新卡怎麼問。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢開口用。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
It's late, the ATM just swallowed your card, and only a security guard is around. This lobby conversation shows you what to say: report the machine number, log your name and time, ask about bank hours, and request a replacement card — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA. Repeat every line in the second half and handle the panic calmly.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🏧提款機吞卡英文｜登記狀況・詢問營業時間・補發新卡｜聽完就會找回卡｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
晚上十點，提款機把你的金融卡吃了進去？
身邊只有保全人員，第一步該怎麼開口？

這一集帶大家走進銀行的夜間大廳，跟著一位慌張的學生從報提款機編號、登記姓名與時間，到確認明天幾點開門、怎麼領回或補發新卡，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
😰 說明狀況：例如「The machine just ate my card!」、「Which ATM number is it?」。
📝 現場登記：例如「Write your name and time.」、「It's my log note; the bank will ask.」。
🕘 後續處理：例如「Better to wait; they open at nine.」、「Just your ID and this note from me.」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

看完這一集，就算半夜丟了卡，你也有辦法把話說明白！
script.thumbnail_action: pointing at an ATM that holds a card inside
script.title_quote: the machine just ate my card

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, the machine just ate my card!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz mi ðə məˈʃin dʒʌst eɪt maɪ kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，那台機器剛把提款卡吞進去了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, happens sometimes. Which ATM number is it?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ həpənz ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz wɪtʃ eɪˌtiˈɛm ˈnʌmbɚ ɪz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 噢，偶爾會這樣。是幾號提款機？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The one by the east door. Number four.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wʌn baɪ ði iːst dɔr ˈnʌmbɚ fɔr/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Did you get a receipt, miss?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt dɪd ju ɡɛt ə rɪˈsit mɪs/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。小姐，您拿到收據了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, nothing came out at all.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，那台什麼都沒吐出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, here — write your name and time.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ hɪr raɪt jɔr neɪm ænd taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 好，來——寫下您的名字和時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For what, exactly? I'm a little lost.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚ wʌt ɪɡˈzæktli aɪm ə ˈlɪtəl lɔst/
dialogue.zh: 這是要做什麼用的？我有點糊塗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's my log note; the bank will ask.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts maɪ lɑɡ noʊt ðə bæŋk wɪl æsk/
dialogue.zh: 這是我的登記單；銀行明天會要求看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ah, got it. Should I call them tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ɡɑt ɪt ʃʊd aɪ kɔl ðɛm təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 啊，懂了。我今晚要先打給銀行嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better to wait; they open at nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtər tə weɪt ðeɪ ˈoʊpən æt naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 最好還是等，他們九點才開門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my card still be inside tomorrow?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl maɪ kɑrd stɪl bi ˌɪnˈsaɪd təˈmɑroʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我的卡明天還會在機器裡面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually yes. Machines get checked each morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuʒəˌwɛli jɛs məˈʃinz ɡɛt tʃɛkt itʃ ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 通常會。每台機器每天早上都會清點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If not, can they just mail me a new one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf nɑt kæn ðeɪ dʒʌst meɪl mi ə nu wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 如果真的找不回來，他們能補寄一張新的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yeah, the bank mails one within a week.
dialogue.phonetic: /jæ ðə bæŋk meɪlz wʌn wɪˈðɪn ə wik/
dialogue.zh: 可以，銀行一週內會寄出新卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. Do I need anything to get mine back?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd du aɪ nid ˈɛniˌθɪŋ tə ɡɛt maɪn bæk/
dialogue.zh: 好。要領回我的卡，需要帶什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just your ID and this note from me.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst jɔr aɪˈdi ænd ðɪs noʊt frʌm mi/
dialogue.zh: 只要您的身分證明，還有我這張單子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, thank you! You really calmed me down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt θæŋk ju ju ˈrɪəli kɑmd mi daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，謝謝您！您真的讓我安心不少。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, miss. Stay warm out there tonight!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛnɪˌtaɪm mɪs steɪ wɔrm aʊt ðɛr təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。外面冷，今晚記得保暖！
